obligations.text: No attempt launches while the run-admission scope is halted for its repository, and none launches when the halt record cannot be read or does not verify.
A halted scope refuses with exit 2 and the closed reason halted naming the scope, the operator and the reason; an unreadable or unverifiable record refuses with halt-state-unreadable.

Halting with a live attempt records stop-requested at once and stop-confirmed only when that attempt's cancelled outcome is durable; no reader reports the halt as effective on the attempt before then.
The halt record lives in the product home, outside any target and outside the confinement, and every change to it appends to the repository's run record.

A halted run-admission scope refuses run with exit 2 naming halted; a truncated, unparsable or chain-mismatched record refuses with halt-state-unreadable; a halt during a live attempt shows stop-requested until the cancelled outcome lands.

record.summary: Adds an operator-written halt record in the product home, per registered repository, with three independently halted scopes: run admission, tool effects and dispatch. run reads it before launch and refuses a halted scope with a closed reason; a halt record it cannot read or verify denies with its own reason rather than admitting. Halting with a live attempt records stop requested; stop confirmed is recorded only when that attempt's cancelled outcome is durable. The hosted tenant halt fact is not defined here; it is consumed once its own spec merges.
record.title: A local halt record that run consults before launch, and denies when it cannot read
